chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Zur'ah, from Mufaddal ibn Umar, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah عليه السلام: May I be made your ransom, the night prayer passes me by, and then I perform the fajr prayer. May I pray after the fajr prayer, before sunrise, while I am still in my prayer place, what I missed of the night prayer?
He said: “Yes, but do not inform your family about it, lest they take it as a sunnah (prophetic tradition).”

key_terms.صَلَاةُ اللَّيْلِ: the night prayer performed during the night as a recommended act of worship

ai.seo_question: Can missed Salat al-Layl be performed after the fajr prayer before sunrise?
ai.summary: This hadith states that one who missed Salat al-Layl may make it up after the fajr prayer and before sunrise. The Imam عليه السلام permits this while cautioning that it should not be publicized to one's family, so that they do not treat it as an established sunnah (prophetic tradition) in that time slot.
